newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FIN MIN WANTS BANK CONSENSUS ON DERIVATIVES TAX.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FIN MIN WANTS BANK CONSENSUS ON DERIVATIVES TAX.

text.p: The Greek finance ministry will do everything in its power to reach accord with banks on a controversial tax on income from synthetic banking products and derivatives, two top government sources told Reuters.

The finance ministry and the Hellenic Bank Association (HBA) agreed last night to set up a six-member committee made up of three finance ministry officials and three HBA representatives to look into the issue.
It is expected to come up with a commonly agreed solution by next week at the latest, the sources said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
